review_findings.title: Pinned conversation is skipped by active fallback
review_findings.details: Reviewer evidence: main_conversation() selects ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id ASC, while conversations() and archive fallback use is_pinned DESC first. After excluding the active conversation, a pinned older conversation can lose to a newer unpinned row. Align main_conversation ordering and add regression coverage.
